findings.first_evidence: src/ui/TextRecipeSettings.tsx:22 -- <input type="number" min={1} max={100} value={recipe.segments} onChange={(e) => change({ ...recipe, segments: Number(e.target.value) })} />
findings.suggested_fix: When a valid segment count decreases, either remove only out-of-range optionalEmpty entries with visible feedback or retain visible removable controls for stale positions. Preserve the selected index visibly for deliberate adjustment; do not clamp it. Add a browser regression: enable optional segment 4, reduce count to 3, resolve the optional setting through the visible UI, then preview and save a valid three-segment source. Also assert an out-of-range selected index stays visible until explicitly adjusted.
findings.title: Keep obsolete optional split positions editable after reducing the count
findings.why_it_matters: Configure a four-segment split selecting segment 1, mark segment 4 optional, then change the expected count to 3. The change retains optionalEmpty:[3], but the optional-position checkboxes now render only positions 1–3. validateWorkflowConfiguration rejects the hidden position as split-index, so a source containing three valid segments cannot preview, download or save even though every visible setting is valid. The user must discover that temporarily restoring count 4 exposes the stale checkbox. This affects ordinary editing of an existing split rule.
findings.validation_reason: The reachable UI sequence of enabling optional segment 4 and reducing the count from 4 to 3 preserves optionalEmpty:[3] in TextRecipeSettings.tsx:22 while line 31 hides its checkbox; MappingRows.tsx:95 and Workspace.tsx:98 pass that recipe through unchanged, so validation.ts:84 rejects the hidden position and recipes.ts:53 and workflows/codec.ts:5 block evaluation and saving; the new U6 editor introduces this path, confirmed by source inspection, with user incidence not measured.
